text:
maria: Heads-up 11 onboarding intake from AquaLab. Theyre asking to run a custom 13B toxicology summarizer in Dedicated (single-tenant), must support PHI stripping, end-to-end audit logs, and FIPS-compliant KMS/HSM. Target go-live in ~4 weeks. Uploaded intake doc + sample prompts to the bucket.

tom: Nice. Do they expect batching? What throughput/latency targets? Any embedding/reranker components?

maria: Throughput: steady 5 QPS with 30 QPS burst. Latency target p95 < 600ms for 1024 tokens. They will call as a summarizer pipeline (chunk -> summarize -> concat) so per-chunk latency matters. No embeddings for now but may add reranker later.

ollie: Please confirm model artifact format (HF, .pt, ONNX) and whether they plan post-training quantization. Also need a list of regulatory documents for the HSM onboarding.

inc-bot: Intake registered: INT-AL-2026-77  assigned: cs-ops  priority: P2  ticket: CS-ONB-7812

maria: Uploaded: gs://redwood-cs/aqualab/aqualab_intake_v1.json and samples gs://redwood-cs/aqualab/samples.csv. Customer link: https://aqualab.share/oncology-summaries. They say model is exported as HF 13b in safetensors, will try 4-bit quant for perf.

tom: For p95 <600ms on 1024 tokens with 13B we should consider dedicated instance sizing (A100s or similar) or token-aware batching. I'll draft candidate HW configs and perf tradeoffs.

ollie: Eval ask: they want safety/evidence extraction and PHI redaction checks. Requesting an "attack set" of 250 adversarial prompts and 500 golden examples. Can we ask them to supply those? Also request a list of fields they consider PHI and which fields are allowed in transcripts.

maria: I'll request the attack/golden sets and a security contact. Also note renewal risk: procurement warned that if audit logs are not exportable within 2 weeks of GA they may pause renewal discussions. Flagging as high priority for compliance.

tom: Noted. For rollout propose: internal QA -> private canary (10%) -> expanded canary (50%) -> full on Dedicated. Canary period 14 days with safety/regression checks. Auto-rollbacks enabled for evidence drop >3% or PHI leakage incidents.

ollie: Eval plan (I'll own): run 10k prompts including attack set, compute ROUGE and hallucination rate, PHI detection recall/precision, and latency percentiles. Using harness:
python run_eval.py --model s3://aqualab/13b.safetensors \
                   --prompts gs://redwood-cs/aqualab/samples.csv \
                   --attack gs://redwood-cs/aqualab/attack_set.csv \
                   --metrics rouge,hallucination,phi_leak,latency \
                   --baseline redwood-13b-summarizer

Expect first-pass results in 48 hours. If 4-bit quant causes >4% ROUGE drop vs baseline we recommend dedicated 16-bit nodes or kernel tuning.

maria: Customer asked for partial log access (redacted) and a CSV export of inference traces daily. Confirming allowed fields now.

tom: Also confirm whether they need model weights stored in their cloud or in our S3. If they want BYO storage we need signed access + key rotation notes.

maria: They prefer us to store weights in their S3 with cross-account role. I'll add S3 access checklist to the intake and circulate HSM provisioning steps.

ollie: Good. I'll prepare an eval ticket and attach to CS-ONB-7812. Will ping when results are in.

maria: Scheduling sync with eng + security tomorrow 9:30am PT. Will update thread after that.
